description: Land Title Settlement Department - Gampolawela, Ganga Ihala Korale D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320746 (23/0069)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and property ownership matters. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of titles for specific land parcels, including detailed schedules listing parcel numbers, extents, owners' names, and property encumbrances. The content falls under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4, specifically covering land registrations, title determinations, and property ownership details without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
